item.title: Shorter peripheral magnetic stimulation protocol may match standard length for upper trapezius myofascial pain
item.description: A 10-minute repetitive peripheral magnetic stimulation protocol was as effective as a 15-minute protocol for pain improvement in patients with upper trapezius myofascial pain syndrome.

item.title: Study co-designed with people with spinal cord injury tests exercise for chronic pain
item.description: Exercise prescribed per international spinal cord injury guidelines can reduce chronic pain intensity when performed in everyday settings, according to a study shaped by people with spinal cord injury.

item.title: Little-understood brain region tracks gap between expectations and reality
item.description: Adapting to changing situations requires people to continuously revise expectations about what might happen next when new information becomes available, and a poorly understood brain region appears to track this gap.

item.title: Targeted radiation shows promise for life-threatening kidney cancer complication
item.description: When Diane Gentry, a 71-year-old retiree from Watauga, Texas, was diagnosed with stage 4 kidney cancer in 2015, she learned the tumor had grown into her veins, a life-threatening complication that targeted radiation may help address.
